fusions.name: Snatched Morsel
fusions.desc: Darts at an enemy up to 3 tiles away and tears off a mouthful for 8 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt. Holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Banquet Raid
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 6 tiles away, where the swarm strips every enemy within 2 tiles of you for 12 damage. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Pick the Bones
fusions.desc: The swarm strips every body within 6 tiles, up to 5; each gives back 7% of your health.

fusions.name: Whetted Appetite
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you heal for 20% of the damage you deal for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
